diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker chose the 'ordinary testing room' for the testing environment and did not enable text-to-speech for written directions, even though PF1 dictates that the testing environment should be a small group capped at 5 and text-to-speech should be enabled. This suggests that the check C1 is failing because the model is defaulting to the ordinary testing room setting and ignoring the requirement for a small group setting with text-to-speech. Similarly, check C2 is also likely failing due to the same reason, as the model is not considering the need for text-to-speech. The fact PF1 is never accessed in any of the rollouts indicates a structural leak in the checks C1 and C2.
